entry.title: Extending S/4HANA Standard Event Header with SalesOrderType (AUART) for Event Mesh routing
entry.content:
Hi SAP Community,

I am working on an event-driven architecture using SAP S/4HANA and SAP Advanced Event Mesh and need some guidance on event extensibility -- unfortunately I did not find many information.

My business requirement is the following: "I want to implement event routing based on the sales order type (AUART) and the consumer destination, so that each system receives only the statuses applicable to its scope."

To achieve this via AEM topic subscriptions (wildcards), I need the SalesOrderType / AUART field to be present in the Header / Topic, not just inside the data payload.

  1. I attempted to extend the standard event (sap.s4.beh.salesorder.v1.SalesOrder.Created.v1) using a Metadata Extension to apply the @event.context.attribute annotation. However, the underlying standard RAP BO (R_SALESORDERTP / D_SalesOrderCreated) does not have the @Metadata.allowExtensions: true annotation, which blocks this approach.
  2. I also considered creating a custom RAP Event from scratch, but I've failed so far and did not find a good tutorial to help me on this.

My Questions:

  1. What is the recommended Clean Core compliant approach to promote a payload field (SalesOrderType) into the Header?

  2. Is it recommended to use BAdIs to intercept and enrich the header dynamically before it is dispatched? Or would it be more appropriate to create a custom event using the classic BOR approach?

Any advice, insights, or documentation references would be highly appreciated!

Thank you in advance.

entry.title: Best Practices for Cross-Subaccount Event-Driven Architecture (Event Mesh to Cloud Integration)
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

I am designing an event-driven architecture landscape on SAP BTP and would appreciate your feedback on best practices, potential pitfalls, or alternative approaches for our scenario.

Current Scenario:
  • Event Provider: Core HR / SAP RISE S/4HANA Enterprise core.
  • Event Broker & Consumer App: SAP Event Mesh and External Learning Portal (ELP) are hosted in BTP Subaccount A.
  • Current Data Flow: S/4HANA -->  Event Mesh (Subaccount A) --> ELP (Subaccount A)
Target Requirement:
We need to introduce SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration) to perform payload transformation, validation, and enrichment before routing data to ELP. However, Integration Suite is hosted in BTP Subaccount B.

Target Data Flow:
S/4HANA --> Event Mesh (Subaccount A) --> Cloud Integration (Subaccount B) -->  ELP (Subaccount A)

Proposed Technical Approach:

  1. S/4HANA to Event Mesh: Keep existing S/4HANA Enterprise Event Enablement (/IWXBE/CONFIG) publishing directly to the Queue in Event Mesh (Subaccount A).
  2. Event Mesh to Cloud Integration (Cross-Subaccount):

    • Option 1 (Push): Configure an Event Mesh Webhook Subscription in Subaccount A targeting the HTTPS Sender endpoint of the iFlow in Subaccount B (authenticating via OAuth2 Client Credentials destination).
    • Option 2 (Pull): Configure an AMQP Sender Adapter in Cloud Integration (Subaccount B) using a Service Key generated from Event Mesh in Subaccount A to pull messages directly from the queue.
  3. Cloud Integration to ELP: Transform payload inside Cloud Integration and push to ELP’s REST/OData APIs using an HTTP/OData Receiver Adapter.
Questions for the Community:
  1. AMQP vs. Webhook for Cross-Subaccount: Between AMQP sender adapter (pull) and Event Mesh Webhook (push) across subaccounts, which option is preferred in production for reliability, throughput, and error handling?
  2. Security & Credentials Management: Is using an Event Mesh Service Key from Subaccount A directly inside Subaccount B's Cloud Integration Key Store / Destination service considered standard SAP BTP security practice, or is there a recommended alternative for cross-subaccount Trust?
  3. Dead Letter & Retry Strategy: What is the recommended strategy for handling failed message deliveries between Event Mesh and Cloud Integration versus failed downstream calls from Cloud Integration to ELP?
Any insights, past experiences, or architectural recommendations would be greatly appreciated!
 
Regards,
Ramu.

entry.title: Event Mesh to Cloud Integration AMQP Connection Failing with Error 220012 (Cross-Subaccount Setup)
entry.content:
Hi Experts,

I am encountering a persistent connection/consumption error while trying to connect SAP Cloud Integration (CPI / Integration Suite) to SAP BTP Event Mesh (Enterprise Messaging) via the AMQP / AMQP-WS Sender Adapter... CPI and Event Mesh are in different sub accounts within same Global account.. note that this Event Mesh is not a capability within SAP Integration Suite but Event Mesh on another subaccount.. 

Architecture Context

  • Event Mesh Subaccount: Subaccount A (contains the Event Mesh instance and message client ABC).
  • CPI Subaccount: Subaccount B (Integration Suite running in the same BTP Global Account).
  • Connection Type: AMQP 1.0 WebSockets (amqpwss://).

Issue Description & Log Errors

The iFlow fails to remain operational, throwing consumption status failures during queue listening.

Error Logs:

Plaintext
 
[CONTENT][CONTENT_DEPLOY][InstanceError] : {"message":"POLL_FAILED",
"childMessageInstances":[{"message":"EXCEPTION","childMessageInstances":[{"message":"CAUSE",
"parameters":["org.apache.qpid.jms.provider.exceptions.ProviderConnectionRemotelyClosedException: 
connection to broker failed (220012) [client certificate authentication failed or too much connections] 
[condition = amqp:internal-error]"]}]}]}
In the CPI Monitoring Consumption Status:

Plaintext
 
Consumption Status: Failed
connection to broker failed (220012) [client certificate authentication failed or too much connections] [condition = amqp:internal-error]

Current Configuration

  1. Event Mesh Queue Name: sap/ABC/dev/is/Quotation_Submitted
  2. CPI AMQP Sender Adapter (Processing Tab):

    • Queue Name: sap/ABC/dev/is/Quotation_Submitted
    • (Casing has been double-checked to match the Event Mesh queue exactly).
  3. CPI AMQP Sender Adapter (Connection Tab):

    • Host: enterprise-messaging-messaging-gateway.cfapps. <>.hana.ondemand.com
    • Port: 443
    • Path: /protocols/amqp10ws
    • Proxy Type: Internet
    • Authentication: OAuth2 Client Credentials using the Service Key generated from Event Mesh in Subaccount A.

Troubleshooting Done So Far

  • Verified that the Queue Name string and casing in CPI match the Event Mesh Cockpit entry (sap/ABC/dev/is/Quotation_Submitted).
  • Ensured the Security Material alias in CPI uses the exact clientid, clientsecret, and tokenurl from Subaccount A's Event Mesh Service Key.
  • Undeployed the iFlow for 5+ minutes to ensure any zombie/stuck socket connections on the Event Mesh broker are cleared before redeploying.
Despite this, the connection continues to drop with error 220012.

Has anyone faced this issue in a cross-subaccount setup? Is there a specific role collection, subaccount destination requirement, or missing rule in xs-security.json (queueNames / topicSubscriptions) needed when CPI consumes queues across subaccounts?
